Logged-in user has the dictionaries privilege (the Settings > Content Filters entry is registered with privileges {dictionaries: 1}); admin has all privileges
steps: Open #/settings/content-filters and wait for the 'Filter Conditions' tab button to be visible
Click the 'Filter Conditions' button
Click [data-test-id="add-new-filter-condition"]
Wait for the modal heading 'Add New Filter Condition' to be visible
Do not click Save
notes: Replaces the old field-list screenshot (image380), which predates the Profile and Embargo fields. Template: scripts/apps/content-filters/views/manage-filter-conditions.html. The Field select is ng-model filterCondition.field with options labelled by getLabelForFieldId, so the option text for the profile field is 'Profile'. With the 'in' operator the Values control is an sd-meta-terms term editor (add button, then pick from the dropdown list). Cleanup: press Escape or click 'Cancel' in the modal footer.

Optional: a content filter exists to pick in 'Content filter'. The main snapshot may have none; leave the field empty in that case
steps: Open #/settings/internal-destinations and wait for [data-test-id="list-page--add-item"] to be visible
Click [data-test-id="list-page--add-item"]
Fill [data-test-id="list-page--new-item"] [data-test-id="gform-input--name"] with 'Politics to World'
Do not click [data-test-id="item-view-edit--save"]
notes: Replaces image19 (old modal 'Edit Destination' with customer desk names). On develop the form opens as a side panel of the generic list page (scripts/apps/internal-destinations/InternalDestinations.tsx). Field test ids follow gform-input--<field>: name, is_active, filter, desk, stage, macro, send_after_schedule; the desk combobox pattern comes from e2e/client/playwright/internal-destinations.crud.spec.ts. The desk option button's accessible name may include more text (the e2e spec clicks a button named 'Sports Desk'), hence the has-text filter on the button.

caption: The General tab of a Subscriber
preconditions: e2e main snapshot: one subscriber 'Subscriber 1' with at least one destination
Done by seed.py: Optional: 'General news' product from the product-subscribers-tab entry, so the Products field is not empty
steps: Open #/settings/publish and wait for [data-test-id="subscriber-item"] to be visible
Wait for the modal heading 'Edit Subscriber' to be visible
Make sure the 'General' wizard step is active
Do not click Save
notes: Replaces image397 (part of the old form). Template: scripts/apps/publish/views/subscribers.html. The schedule block is the form__row with label 'Subscriber Schedule Settings' and two sd-date-picker elements (labels 'Start Date', 'End Date'). With Status active and Start Date today, no warning is shown; a start date in the future would show the 'Active switch will override' warning, which is fine but not needed. Crop the top of the modal (Status, schedule, Name, E-Mail to broadcast Kill Events, Target Type, Media Type, Subscriber codes, Targetable by users). Cleanup: click 'Cancel' in the modal footer. If the date steps do not resolve, set the dates through the picker popup (click the calendar button of each sd-date-picker and pick the day), or PATCH the subscriber's schedule before capture ({"schedule": {"start_date": "<today>", "end_date": "<today+30>"}}) and skip the two date steps. Capture: the start date is today, picked in the calendar popup (the start date cannot be in the past); the end date is typed key by key as a fixed date (31/12/2027, update it once that is close), because the PrimeReact calendar ignores fill and the 'set the date' step only finds [data-test-id="date-input"]. Escape after each date only closes the calendar popup.

notes: New shot. Template: scripts/apps/desks/views/content-expiry.html used from desk-config-modal.html (data-header 'Content Expiry', context 'System'). When the switch is on the row shows number inputs with 'days', 'hr' and 'min'.
